units.source_text: 且说源氏想替明石道人向住吉明神还愿，同时明石女御所许下的愿，也须到住吉去还，

en.t: Genji wished to fulfill the Akashi Novice's vow to Sumiyoshi Myojin on his behalf, and the vow made by the Akashi Consort also had to be fulfilled at Sumiyoshi,

units.source_text: 他就打开道人所送来的那只箱子，

en.t: so he opened the box that the Novice had sent him,

units.source_text: 但见愿文中许着许多大愿，例如每年春秋演奏神乐，祈愿子孙世代必定繁昌。

en.t: and saw that the vow texts contained many great pledges, such as performing kagura every spring and autumn to pray that his descendants would surely prosper for generations.

units.source_text: 非有源氏的威势，办不到这大规模的还愿，

en.t: Without Genji's authority, such a large-scale fulfillment of vows could not be carried out,

units.source_text: 明石道人显然是预料到的。

en.t: and the Akashi Novice had plainly foreseen this.

units.source_text: 这些愿文写得笔致非常流畅，才气横溢，而措辞谨严，

en.t: These vow texts were written in an exceptionally fluent hand, full of talent, yet with strict and reverent wording,

units.source_text: 显然句句可以感动神佛。

en.t: so that every line clearly seemed capable of moving the gods and Buddhas.

units.source_text: 遁迹深山、专心修道的人，对世俗之事能如此考虑周到，

en.t: That a man who had withdrawn deep into the mountains and devoted himself to religious practice could think so carefully about worldly affairs

units.source_text: 源氏觉得深可怜悯，而又觉得不合身份。

en.t: made Genji feel deeply sorry for him, while also feeling that it was unbecoming of his station.

units.source_text: 料想是个古代圣僧，为了宿世因缘，暂时下凡入世。

en.t: He supposed the man must be a holy monk from ancient times who, because of karmic ties from former lives, had temporarily descended into the world.

units.source_text: 他仔细寻思，越发觉得这明石道人不可忽视了。

en.t: As he pondered it carefully, he felt all the more that this Akashi Novice could not be taken lightly.
